# Acceptance Criteria Skill

Write observable outcomes, not implementation tasks. Prefer Given/When/Then for user workflows and explicit measurable thresholds for quality attributes. Include success, validation error, permission denial, boundary, duplicate/retry and dependency-failure paths. Each criterion gets a stable `AC-*` ID and links to its parent requirement. State test data, preconditions and evidence required. A criterion is not satisfied because code exists; it is satisfied only when evidence demonstrates the outcome.
